thread:
leo: Heads-up — staging escort queue is backed up, signer nodes reporting a 45m lag. Packaging for private/vpc 1.4.7 (installer + sealed bundle) is blocked. Anyone on signer lane?

olivia: seeing the same. cosign index job stuck on signer-2 with timeout errors. quick tail of the job: 
```
ERROR: failed to upload signature: 503 Service Unavailable
at upload.signer (signer-2): connection reset by peer
```

sophia: deploybot shows a retry loop — it’s attempted 3 times and is holding the manifest in escort-queue. if we wait, canary window shifts by ~2h. not ideal.

leo: do we have an alternate signer? dave, maya — any spare HSM-backed signer nodes we can route to? @deploybot any auto-fallback configured?

deploybot: manifest-escort: queued(manifest=private-vpc-1.4.7, stage=staging). retries=3. auto-fallback=off for sealed-manifests. manual reroute required.

dave: we have a spare signer in eu-west but it's soft-locked by a hotfix session. can free in ~30m but need owner signoff.

maya: I'm on the hotfix, can't release lock until checks pass. ETA 28m.

olivia: two choices: 1) wait for 30m and continue with sealed bundle signing (preferred), or 2) fastback: cut the delta that requires cosign and ship an unsigned delta to escort-only customers, then patch later. both have tradeoffs.

sophia: fastback seems risky for compliance; we have enterprise customers expecting signed artifacts for on-prem installs. also release notes will need a clear caveat.

leo: agreement: no unsigned artifacts for Private deployments. we can't short-circuit signing.

olivia: if we wait, we need to hold canary start window and alert on the release timeline. ops, can you extend the deploy window by 1h?

dave: I can push a 1h delay on the canary. doing now.

deploybot: canary-window: start delayed by 60m for manifest private-vpc-1.4.7. notification sent to #release-watch.

maya: signer lock released. freeing node and triggering cosign job now.

olivia: re-triggering packaging pipeline: `./scripts/package-installer --manifest=private-vpc-1.4.7 --cosign=true --seal=true`

deploybot: packaging started (job id: pkg-311345). cosign attempt 1/5.

leo: quick checklist before canary: pin image digest in release notes, confirm KMS key id used for cosign, update release notes with signed artifact hashes. we should also record fallback criteria: if cosign fails after 5 attempts, we abort and create hotfix branch.

sophia: adding those to the release checklist now. also updating the rollback play: if canary error rate >1.5% tokenization failures or installer checksum mismatch on >2 nodes, roll back to 1.4.6 and notify customers.

olivia: cosign succeeded on attempt 2. signatures uploaded. hashes: 
- installer: sha256:aa3f...c12e
- sealed-bundle: sha256:7b9a...8f3d

deploybot: manifest-escort: manifest signed and moved to ready-for-canary.

leo: great. start canary in 10m. olivia, please push release notes with the pinned digests and a short note about the delayed window. make sure the private docs mention the KMS key id.

olivia: on it. release notes snippet: 
"Private/VPC 1.4.7 — packaging delay due to signer queue; signatures now applied. Installer and sealed bundle pinned to digests above. Canary start delayed by 1h. If you use airgap, verify checksums before install."

maya: confirmed signer metrics look normal now. will watch for any cosign flaps during the canary.

sophia: setting alert: if deploybot reports packaging->canary latency > 90m or any checksum mismatch, page oncall.

leo: final: no rollback unless threshold breached. if rollback triggered, dave will run `revert-release --to=1.4.6 --reason=signer-failure` and we will open a follow-up postmortem. everyone ack? :thumbsup:

dave: 👍

olivia: 👍 pushed release notes and pinned manifests.

maya: 👍 monitoring.
